Central research

Publications (professional) and Patents
Nearly 40 U.S. patents and more than 40 polymer literature works, focusing on the discussion of multiphase polymer mixing processing and physical properties, and plastic powder mechanics (將近40個美國專利,及40多篇高分子文獻著作, 著重於討論多相高分子混練加工與物性,以及塑料粉體力學)

Accomplishments
1. BF Goodrich, Distinguished Corporate Inventor Award honored at The National Inventors Hall of Fame induction, 1993 (Akron, Ohio)

2. Member of The American Society of Patent Holders

3. 雷射3D印表機塑料粉粒的研發及上市

4.(滷素及無滷素）奈米複合材料耐燃可塑性橡膠研發及上市

5. 與食物接觸的非滷素可塑性橡膠瓶蓋密封膠研發及上市

Hobby
Rose Gardening and Photography (玫瑰園藝及攝影)

Notable Accomplishments

BF Goodrich Distinguished Corporate Inventor Award honored at The National Inventors Hall of Fame induction, 1993 (Akron, Ohio)

Member of The American Society of Patent Holders

Nearly 40 U.S. patents and more than 40 polymer literature works, focusing on multiphase polymer mixing processing and physical properties, and plastic powder mechanics

Research and commercialization of plastic powder particles for laser 3D printers (雷射3D印表機塑料粉粒的研發及上市)

Research and commercialization of halogen and halogen-free nano-composite flame-retardant thermoplastic rubber (奈米複合材料耐燃可塑性橡膠研發及上市)

Research and commercialization of non-halogen thermoplastic rubber bottle cap sealant for food contact applications (與食物接觸的非滷素可塑性橡膠瓶蓋密封膠研發及上市)

Non-professional publication: 《心緒森林》(288頁, 2019年6月)
